# Vendored tools

`zirbel-core-2.0.0.tgz` and `zirbel-engineering-1.0.0.tgz` are retained from td01 with their
existing integrity pins. Zirbel core supplies publication-manifest validation; engineering supplies
the public Chrome test adapter. Both declare MIT. The matching upstream notice is retained in
[zirbel-LICENSE.txt](zirbel-LICENSE.txt), including for engineering whose original archive lacks a LICENSE file.
No archive was repacked. Neither tool requires a private registry or sibling source checkout.
